title: Derived direct image preserves direct sums
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then the derived direct image $Rf_*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image, def-pc-derived-category] commutes with all set-indexed direct sums.

proof.text: Choose representatives of each Rf_* E_i using essential surjectivity of DerivedCategory.Q. Apply [lem-pc-derived-ambient-direct-sums] to obtain a target coproduct cocone whose cohomology comparison is an isomorphism in every degree. This does not require a pre-existing HasColimit instance for the ambient derived category.

For any colimit cocone c of the source family, form its mapped cofan. The target coproduct universal property gives a comparison morphism. For every integer q apply [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-cohomology-coproduct] to c. Prove, by extensionality on the cohomology coprojections and functoriality, that the source cohomology-coproduct isomorphism followed by H^q of the comparison equals the fixed-degree direct-image comparison. Cancel the first isomorphism to prove H^q of the comparison is invertible.

Mathlib DerivedCategory.isIso_iff makes the comparison invertible since all its cohomology maps are. IsColimit.ofPointIso transports the target coproduct universal property to the mapped cofan. Write its desc, factorization and uniqueness fields for the actual functor-mapped cocone. This proves PreservesColimit for each discrete family, including the empty family.
